question: In a uniform electrostatic field, a student draws field lines parallel to each other but with unequal spacing. Is the drawing correct? Give a reason.

options.A: No; in a uniform electric field, field lines must be parallel and equally spaced
options.B: Yes; unequal spacing still represents a uniform electric field
options.C: No; in a uniform electric field, field lines must be curved and equally spaced
options.D: Yes; parallel lines always represent a uniform field irrespective of spacing
